title: Micron advanced HBM4 capability and high-volume shipment milestones
canonical_summary: Micron reports described HBM4 bandwidth capability, high-volume shipment for a lead customer's platform and production for NVIDIA's Vera Rubin ecosystem.
known_event_summary: September 1-3, 2026 Micron HBM4 milestone: HBM4 entered high-volume/production shipment descriptions, delivered more than 2.8 TB/s bandwidth and supported NVIDIA Vera Rubin.

facts.proposition: Micron Technology's HBM4 memory was in high-volume shipments for its lead customer's platform.
Micron's HBM4 delivers more than 2.8 terabytes per second of bandwidth.
Micron produces HBM4 high bandwidth memory for integration into Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform.
